applies_to: iSMA CONTROLLI Touch Point 2.0 room panels (software manual V1.0.1).
summary: The Touch Point 2.0 room panel has the same room objects as the first Touch Point (temperature, humidity, CO2, setpoint with offset, fan, occupancy, CO2 alarm) and adds seven generic buttons with their own mode, state and LED objects, a screen-select mode, buzzer tone and a USB on/off switch.
notes: The manual table mixes objects and object properties. Only Present Value rows are listed; other property rows (offsets, filters, limits, visibility, Device-object properties such as BACNET_DEVICE_ID and BAUD_RATE) are left out.
Rows with a blank access cell (mostly BO display switches) are taken as writable.
Fan objects (MV 0-2, BO 58, BO 60) are not available on the Touch Point VAV series.
The generic-button objects are printed as ranges (MV 21-27, BV 56-62, BV 63-69, BV 70-76); each range is shown by its first object, button 1.

source.title: Touch Point 2.0 Software User Manual V1.0.1 - List of BACnet Objects

integration.summary: Read the room temperature (AI 4), humidity (AI 5), CO2 (AI 6) and effective setpoint (AI 3); write the setpoint (AV 56), fan mode (MV 1) and occupancy mode (MV 4) from the BMS. BO 62 switches occupancy between local and BMS mode; BI 0 is the CO2 alarm.
integration.enable: BO 62 OCCUPANCY_CONFIG_LOCAL_MODE selects local or BMS occupancy mode.
setup: Device instance and baud rate are Device-object properties (BACNET_DEVICE_ID default 0xFFFFFFFF, BAUD_RATE default 11520 = 115200 bps).
gotchas: Setpoint objects use tenths in the defaults (DEFAULT_SETPOINT 210 = 21.0 °C); check scaling before writing.
Configuration objects are stored in panel memory; avoid cyclic writes.
